import html # Example template; in real usage this would be defined elsewhere BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML snippet. """ # Escape any potentially dangerous characters safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Safely format the template try: formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_content) except KeyError as exc: raise ValueError(f"Template missing placeholder: {exc}") from None return formatted
